title: Remove timer-based service detail projection wait
observed_behavior: The service detail route waited for relay-backed service projections with SERVICE_DETAIL_WAIT_MS, SERVICE_DETAIL_POLL_MS, sleep(), and a polling loop.
intended_behavior: The service detail route performs relay read-model bootstrap and then reacts to deterministic service store updates delivered by 30900 read-model events, preserving existing loading, error, and detail UI states without timer-based completion detection.
out_of_scope: Go internal/service SecurityScanner fixture work tracked by sibling issue bahia-x3km
